title: Wallace Token & Cost Audit Report
description: Aggregated token usage and USD cost report across Antigravity IDE and CLI brain directories, grouped by timeframe, project, feature, or conversation.

group_by.description: Entity grouping dimension applied to the buckets array.

period.description: Timeframe bucketing mode applied to turns.

interval.description: Custom duration specification when period is 'interval', else empty.

totals.description: Grand total token counts and USD cost across all buckets.

buckets.description: Ordered list of aggregated token usage buckets.

bucket.description: Aggregated token usage and USD cost bucket.

period.description: Timeframe bucket label (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-Www, YYYY-MM, interval, or '*').

period_start.description: ISO-8601 start date or timestamp of the timeframe bucket, or empty string.

source.description: Origin environment (ide, cli, standalone, mixed, or none).

project.description: Resolved project name or '*' when aggregated across projects.

feature.description: Resolved Work Package, git branch, root title, or '*'.

conversation_id.description: Conversation UUID when grouped by conversation, else empty string.

title.description: Conversation title when grouped by conversation, else empty string.

conversation_count.description: Number of conversations included in this bucket.

turn_count.description: Number of LLM generation turns included in this bucket.

total_tokens.description: Sum of input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, and output_tokens.

cost_usd.description: Estimated total USD cost rounded to 6 decimal places.
